items.quote: And so that is one reason that I support the bipartisan Fast Tracking European Investment in Ukraine's Defense Act.

This legislation would make it easier for NATO allies and other designated partners to purchase and transfer certain defensive munitions to Ukraine while maintaining congressional notification safeguards against unauthorized retransfer.

When the Senate returns in November, we must pass BAAJA and provide needed certainty for critical infrastructure projects across the country. 

We cannot hope to be a global leader of industry if we cannot build.
items.promise: Said the Senate must pass BAAJA permitting reform when it returns in November.

items.quote:
The ONLY way to lower gas and utility prices in the long term is comprehensive, durable permitting reform. The BAAJA deal introduced last month is the solution. 

Let’s get America building again!
items.promise: Said comprehensive permitting reform via BAAJA is the only long-term way to lower gas and utility prices.

items.quote: I came to the Senate to help America build again. This bipartisan deal is a huge step forward in that mission to strengthen American energy, manufacturing, and infrastructure!

It shouldn't take decades to build critical infrastructure.

The bipartisan permitting bill announced last week cuts red tape, grows our grid, maintains critical environmental protections, and - most importantly - helps America build again!

America’s ambitions to strengthen energy security, reshore manufacturing, and lead the world in artificial intelligence depend on one fundamental capability: our ability to build.

BAAJA is the solution to get America building again.
The ONLY way to lower fuel and utility prices in the long-term is for Congress to pass meaningful, durable permitting reform. Let's get it done!

I spent 40 years as a field engineer building infrastructure. I can tell you firsthand: America is slowly strangling itself with regulatory red tape. 

Everyone in Washington knows permitting is broken, but politicians keep pushing it down the road for short-term political games.
This bill forces those primary countries keeping Russia's economy afloat to make a simple yet critical choice--a choice between doing business with America or buying cheap Russian energy.
This legislation tells Russia's customers that the United States of America will not sit by while they fund Putin's assault.
As your Senator, I will fight tirelessly to PASS the SAVE America Act, and support eliminating the filibuster to do so.
items.promise: Said she will fight to pass the SAVE America Act and support ending the filibuster to do so.

items.quote: If the filibuster is the only thing standing in the way of passing the SAVE America Act, then I'm a YES vote to end it.
items.promise: Said she will vote yes to end the filibuster if that is required to pass the SAVE America Act.

items.quote:
The American people are demanding immediate action from Congress on election integrity. That’s why the SAVE America Act is the first bill I am cosponsoring in the Senate. 

These reforms are common sense and need to be enacted quickly.

I strongly support the Second Amendment.
 
I believe gun control is how steady you hold your weapon.

The truth about Annie Andrews: Her primary profession is as a gun control activist.  She wants to gut the Second Amendment and confiscate firearms from law-abiding citizens. 

I will always protect South Carolinians' right to keep and bear arms.
items.promise: Said she will always protect South Carolinians' right to keep and bear arms.

items.quote:
About to speak on the Senate floor to urge my colleagues to vote in support of the Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026. 

This bill will provide @POTUS with critical tools as he works to bring peace in Ukraine.

President Trump was elected with a mandate to clean up the immigration catastrophe created under Joe Biden. I applaud the work the President has done to secure the southern border, but there’s more to be done.

I was proud to vote to confirm Todd Blanche as Attorney General of the United States. 

@POTUS couldn’t have chosen a better nominee. Mr. Blanche is highly qualified. I know he will work hard to fight fraud and protect the safety of South Carolinians.

Mr. President, I rise today in support of the 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act--a bipartisan, bicameral effort to address one of the most pressing challenges facing families across the country: the cost and availability of housing.
First, the bill includes the Rural Housing Service Reform Act that I introduced with Senator Smith from Minnesota.
This bill provides the first comprehensive update to USDA's rural housing programs in more than a decade.
Following my letter last week, I’m pleased to see that the President is taking steps to lower fuel prices, including a review of certain taxes on diesel.

Met with a few South Dakota folks with Growth Energy to talk about the need for year-round access to E15. We all appreciated the Senate Ag Committee advancing a Farm Bill that included a provision to allow for year-round access to E15.

Good to visit with South Dakota folks representing Impact Aid schools in our state. These funds are crucial for the success of schools located near large sections of federally-owned land, and I’ll continue to advocate for fully funding this program in the Senate.
items.promise: Said he will continue to advocate for fully funding Impact Aid in the Senate.

items.quote: Visited with SD Secretary of Education, Joseph Graves. We discussed my bill, Returning Education to Our States Act, and the importance of preserving Title I, special education funding and many more critical federal programs.

Today, the Senate votes on war powers resolutions to rein in Trump’s illegal war with Iran.
 
I will vote YES—as I have repeatedly. I encourage my Republican colleagues to join me. We know this is wrong—it’s not a partisan issue.
items.promise: Said he will vote yes on war powers resolutions to rein in Trump's war with Iran.

items.quote:
The Trump Administration is using FISA to spy on you without a warrant—arming Trump’s lawless federal agents with mountains of data, completely unchecked. 
  
I will vote NO on giving Donald Trump and his cronies more power to spy on Americans.
items.promise: Said he will vote no on expanding warrantless FISA surveillance powers.

items.quote:
The vote tonight to reopen the government with no deal on healthcare is a brutal blow to all those who have stood together to save affordable health care for more than 20 million Americans.  

I strived to stop this outcome.  I will vote "NO" tonight with every fiber of my being.
items.promise: Said he will vote no on reopening the government without a health care deal.

items.quote:
I just introduced a War Powers Resolution to rein in Trump’s illegal war with Iran.
 
Democrats are sending a clear message: we’re going to keep voting on these resolutions until they pass.
 
Republicans need to fulfill their oath to the Constitution and vote YES.

Almost unbelievable: Trump has made more stock trades during his second term than ALL of Congress combined.
 
I’m pushing to ban all elected officials—members of Congress, the President, the VP—from buying and trading stocks.
First, my colleagues across the aisle say: We are going to make it very, very hard for people in rural America to get healthcare if they are on Medicaid.
About now, 14 years ago, Senator Sherrod Brown and I introduced the idea that we should end this stock trading, and that means buying, that means selling, and that means holding.

Happy Earth Day! Today, I’m reflecting on the work we must continue to protect the planet we call home. That’s why I’m fighting to pass my bill to help us #BreakFreeFromPlastic pollution, protect our public lands, and pursue bold climate action.
